display_name: Phase1拼接增强/普通PL：96冻结模型统一推理成本
description: 219性能训练全部闭合后，同一空闲GPU2/3测96个冻结checkpoint；合成IQ、零新增训练、无query。
authorization: 用户要求星地测试统一默认拼接增强；半监督只用普通置信度PL并保留监督对照；明确允许撤下未开始GPU的旧扩展并重发，正在训练和历史产物保留。启用时点授权Agent自行判断。用户进一步要求改用另两张空闲卡，当前为物理GPU2、3；此前等待队列零GPU行保留。

code.commit: publisher records actual Git commit in package.json/release_commit.txt
code.environment: N607 existing SDG-SEI Py3.8/torch1.11 + existing isolated NumPy1.23.5; no shared install

data.validation_ref: strict default-head load + CPU real-checkpoint MAC smoke after upstream completes

permissions.claim_scope: latency/MACs on one shared-server GPU under declared idle policy

checkpoint.provenance_verdict: same registered upstream checkpoints, no fitting
checkpoint.selection_rule: all96 fixed tasks; no target selection

execution.gpu_policy: physical2/3 only, one own row worker per card; wait for foreign workloads; no extra GPU for cost queue
execution.stop_rule: wait upstream actual exit and219 complete; then one fixed idle GPU2/3, first technical/contended measurement failure preserves outputs and stops unstarted rows
